title: Venture Global LNG export growth decomposition and 2026 interim observations

sources.document: 2025 Form 10-K, Executive Summary and Our LNG Projects

interpretation: About 96% of 2024-to-2025 LNG export-volume increase occurred at the Plaquemines project; its commissioning/ramp-up is a documented dominant driver of volume growth
Weighted average 2025 LNG selling price decreased even as total export volume and operating income rose
2026 H1 average sales price was below 2025 H1 while volume and operating income increased; supports capacity-driven explanation, not proof of Europe-specific price gains
Plaquemines project volume growth is not independently attributable to Russia sanctions or any European destination
Company-wide operating income includes other costs and businesses and is not LNG destination net profit
2026 H1 values cannot be compared to full-year 2025 as if equal reporting periods
